scripts.check: pnpm run check:js && pnpm run check:dotnet
scripts.check:js: vp check && eslint --max-warnings=0 && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run check:api && pnpm run api:check && node tooling/scripts/check-drift.mjs
scripts.check:dotnet: cd server && dotnet format Orvano.slnx --verify-no-changes && dotnet build Orvano.slnx -p:CI=true --no-incremental
scripts.check:api: spectral lint api/openapi.json api/console.openapi.json api/conformance/fixture.openapi.json --ruleset api/.spectral.yaml --fail-severity warn
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && pnpm --filter @orvano/console typecheck && pnpm --filter @orvano/sdk-generator typecheck
scripts.fix: vp check --fix && eslint --fix && cd server && dotnet format Orvano.slnx
scripts.test: pnpm run test:tooling && pnpm run test:generator && pnpm --filter @orvano/console test && cd server && dotnet test --solution Orvano.slnx
